name: .308 Cal-150gr Power Hammer™

slowestTwist.raw: Required twist rate is 1-12″ or faster

note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This 150gr pure copper Power Hammer™ is replacing the 152gr Hammer Hunter™. It has identical baring surface so it will load nearly identical with little or no change from previous loading. With a slightly larger 2mm hollow point this bullet will have more consistent low vel impact performance. A very good choice for 308 Winchester and up into magnum 30 caliber rifles." The product name says 150 gr; the specification says 151 gr.
